description: This file defines a PHP class for a shipping extension 'Flat' in the OpenCart admin module, handling CRUD operations for flat rate shipping configuration.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: Controller class for managing the flat shipping method configuration in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of the flat shipping settings page, including loading language, setting page title, breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the flat shipping configuration settings via POST request, with permission check and JSON response.
